name: Constable Jonah Reed
description: A steady village constable who keeps the scene calm, notes the order of discoveries, and helps players test whether the locked room was truly locked.

name: Eliza Vane
description: A clever, anxious mechanic who once helped Pendlewick maintain the astronomical clock and resents being treated like a convenient suspect.

name: Crispin Hale
description: A tidy, silver-tongued secretary who speaks carefully about the late patron's affairs and keeps a leather folio close at hand.

name: Nora Bell
description: A practical caretaker with oil-dark sleeves, a tired manner, and a sharp memory for which doors, lamps, and windows were disturbed.
